title: A nonideal clutter without Kiraly choice maps
scope: 11-element nonideal clutter has no p,q on clutter and full blocker satisfying membership and singleton-intersection exclusion; refutes intended nonideal-implies-choice direction

title: A fully supported local intricacy maximum among stationary binary one-step Markov laws
scope: Existence of a fully supported integer-shift-invariant stationary one-step Markov probability law on the full two-sided binary shift locally maximizing rank-zero uniform-subset intricacy relative to all stationary one-step Markov laws in the weak topology, with actual finite-limit convergence at witness and nearby comparison laws

title: A Latin maximum-agreement strategy that is not optimal for the finite field objective
scope: Refutes the universal Latin-implies-optimal direction of the source Definition3 finite field characterization: two nonempty Latin maximum-agreement partitions at n=5 have actual fields290<302. MathDB347712 is interpreted through its explicit source Definition3.

title: A seven-vertex counterexample to the minimum-degree bound for Staller fast Maker-Breaker domination
scope: Sevenvertex simple connected bipartite theta with branchlengths2,2,4 has minimumdegree2 and Staller-start optimalwinningnumber4>ceil(7/2)-2+1=3. Refutes Conjecture7.2(i) and thus MathDB355140 conjunction.

title: No four-label edge coloring of K5 distinguishes all triangles by color sets
scope: Every map E(K5)->Fin 4 has two distinct triangles with equal edge-color sets; refutes Pilsniak-Wozniak arXiv:2407.19050v1 Conjecture 5 (tau_s(n)=n-1 for all n>=4) at n=5. Multiset Conjecture 4 untouched.

title: The prime field is not a maximal clique in GP(5^8,3): a counterexample to Yip's maximal subfield clique conjecture
scope: For q=5^8, d=3 (largest admissible r=1), in every field of order 5^8 the prime field F_5 is a clique of GP(5^8,3) but not maximal (x=2θ+4θ^2+θ^3, f(θ)=0, f=X^8+X^7+2X^6+2). Refutes the unrestricted conjecture; ALCO Theorem 1.2 (q>(n-1)^2) untouched.

title: Complete bipartite graphs maximise sigma_t-irregularity among connected triangle-free graphs
scope: For every n>=2 and every maximiser a of a(n-a)(n-2a)^2 over 1<=a<n, K_{a,n-a} is connected, triangle-free and has sigma_t at least that of every connected triangle-free graph on n vertices; every attainer is complete bipartite with nonempty parts. Proves arXiv:2411.04881v1 Conjecture 24 / Ars Math. Contemp. 26 (2026) Conjecture 6.1 in full.

title: A six-point ordinal space with the majorization property that does not embed in the real line
scope: Six-point tie-free ordinal space whose identity enumeration has the Definition 7.1 majorization property for every chain length (repeats, permutations) but which admits no embedding in R; refutes Keller-Petrov Conjecture 7.4 in the range n>5 left open by the source (sufficiency proved only for n<=4).

title: A 34-vertex maximal rigid diameter-5 subset of the eight-dimensional Hamming cube
scope: Explicit 34-point subset of signed Q_8 with diameter exactly 5, inclusion-maximal subject to diameter <= 5, and a diameter partner at every point; hence b'(8;5) >= 34 > 32, refuting Briggs-Feng-Wells Conjecture 1 (b'(n;r)=2^r for n>=r).

title: A quarter-table change from a group to a classical Moufang loop of order 16
scope: F_2^4 and the cubic code loop on F_2^3 x F_2 are Moufang loops with common identity, associators with images of size 1 and 2 (inequivalent under pointed, unpointed and independent bijective readings), and table distance 64 < 3*16^2/8 = 96; refutes Drapal-Vojtechovsky Conjecture 11.2 in its stated unrestricted scope.

title: Exact super edge-magic total strength of a seven-cycle with four leaves at one vertex
scope: G(7;0,0,0,0,0,0,4) has an SEMT labeling with constant 26 (and sm=26 exactly by an ordinary degree-rearrangement bound), contradicting Deepthi Conjecture 1 sm(G(n;k_1..k_n)) = 2q+(n+3)/2 = 27 on its nonnegative leaf-count domain.

title: An explicit non-collapsing facet of the 4 x 4 x 5 marginal cone
scope: An integral functional exposes a facet of the no-three-way-interaction marginal cone P^{4,4,5} (dimension 43 in a cone of dimension 44) whose five layers have pairwise distinct zero patterns, so it is not a pullback under any state maps to 4x4x4; refutes Eriksson-Fienberg-Rinaldo-Sullivant Conjecture 14.

title: Binary supervenience from unary supervenience on arbitrary ternary frames
scope: On arbitrary ternary frames every formula of the language with two determining inputs is equivalent to one with a single determining input (guard G(A,B)=D1(A; A and B) on the four Boolean cells), so Fan Conjecture 15 (strict hierarchy) fails at n=1; the Section 7.3 relativized agreement is definable; Humberstone 2019 pp. 16-17 undefinability assertion is corrected.

title: A wedge-complement domain with a nonstarlike Cassinian ball
scope: U = C minus the closed wedge {u>=1, |v|<=(u-1)/20} is an open connected proper planar domain, starlike about 0 in both the ordinary and the strict boundary-point sense, yet its Cassinian ball B_c(0,7/4) contains 4+i and omits the midpoint 2+i/2. Klen-Mohapatra-Sahoo Conjecture 4.7 (every Cassinian ball in a starlike domain is starlike about the centre) is false for every n>=2 reading posed in the plane, under both the ordinary and the strict domain hypotheses.

title: All corrected odd-open and even-closed XOR-magic degrees at powers of two
scope: Cichacz-Grochowski-Zuazua Conjecture 25 (arXiv:2512.19278) as printed is false at every n>=4 because closed degree 2^n-4 is excluded by Proposition 24 (Batal); that correction is zero-credit. The intended conjecture (MathDB: 'apart from the degrees excluded by the previously stated nonexistence result') is proved in full: for every n>=4 there are connected simple open zero-XOR graphs on 2^n vertices of every odd degree 5..2^n-5 and closed ones of every even degree 4..2^n-6, which with Proposition 24 is the complete existence picture for the odd-open and even-closed classes.

title: A vertex of the asymmetric subtour elimination polytope on eight nodes that is adjacent to no tour
scope: Vercesi-Barta-Gambardella-Gualandi-Mastrolilli (arXiv:2506.10671) Conjecture 1 states that every vertex of P_ASEP^n has a tour in its neighbourhood. The fractional vertex x*=X/4 of P_ASEP^8 (19 support arcs, 8 tight cuts, rank 56) is adjacent to none of the 5040 tours: for each tour an integer direction certificate shows that [x*,T] is not a face. The conjecture fails at n=8; n=6,7 remain open.

title: An adverse non-Q graph from the cyclic Latin square of order six
scope: The cyclic Latin square graph of order 6 (cells of Z6xZ6 adjacent when sharing a row, column or symbol) has lambda_min = -3 and upsilon = 6, both unchanged after deleting every open neighbourhood, and no isolated vertices, so it is adverse; its stability number is 5 by the transversal parity obstruction, so it is not a Q-graph. This refutes Cardoso-Luz Conjecture 4.2 (survey arXiv:1811.05516, Optimization 69(1) 2020) that all adverse graphs are Q-graphs, also under the JCO 2016 'non complete' reading.

title: A clique with a five-edge tail reverses the hubs-biased Kirchhoff ordering
scope: Estrada-Mugnolo (J. Math. Anal. Appl. 507 (2022) 125728, arXiv:2101.07103) Conjecture 4.13 asserts R_1 >= R_0 >= R_-1 for hubs-biased Kirchhoff indices, with equality iff regular. The spectral index the authors computed (Lemma 4.6, n*tr of the group inverse) satisfies the ordering for all 12,103 connected graphs with 5<=n<=8 (independent review), but K6 with a pendant five-edge path has R_1 = 1696684/14035 < 370/3 = R_0. The literal Moore-Penrose reading (4.3) also fails there (515538204/7137235) and already fails at n=5, an uncredited source inconsistency.

title: A parity-corrected potential proves the Elsholtz–Klahn–Lipnik four-term progression-free digit-set conjecture
scope: Elsholtz-Klahn-Lipnik (Des. Codes Cryptogr. 91 (2023) 1443-1452, arXiv:2211.02588) Conjecture 2.4, repeated as Conjecture 4.6 in Lipnik's 2023 thesis: for every prime p >= 13, p = 1 mod 4, and every n divisible by (p+3)/2, S(D,n) with D = {0..(p-1)/2,(p+3)/2} has no nonconstant 4-term AP. Proved uniformly (primality unnecessary) via E(t) = 4t^2 - (3p-5)(-1)^t: the only wrapped coordinate progressions are (h-3,0,h,3) and (3,h,0,h-3), with gap 16; ordinary progressions have gap 16 s^2; equal digit frequencies force every gap to vanish.

title: No order-15 circulant has diameter 2 and monophonic position number 2
scope: Tuite-Thomas-Chandran (arXiv:2106.06827v3; Ars Math. Contemp. 2025) Conjecture 4.5 asserts that for every n >= 11 there is a circulant graph of order n with diameter 2 and monophonic position number 2 (still listed as open in the survey arXiv:2501.19385 v5, August 2026). False at the interior order 15. Every diameter-2 circulant of order 15 contains a triangle, or is C5[3K1] (jumps {1,4,6} or {2,3,7}) with three open twins; both kinds of triple are mp-sets. Verified circulant examples exist at every other order 11..40 (supplementary; not claimed beyond).

title: A cubic counterexample to edge-pattern convex domination
scope: Pirot-Sereni (arXiv:1904.05618; SIAM J. Discrete Math. 35(4) (2021) 2815-2843) Conjecture 2, also Conjecture 1.5.1 of Pirot's 2019 thesis, is false at d = 3, r = 2. The 8-vertex edge-rooted pattern P (root edge 01; edges 01,02,03,15,17,34,46,56: a 6-cycle with two pendants) is 3-regular, of exact depth 2 and girth 6, with e(P) = (2/5,14/5,4/5). With alpha = (1/1000,7/27,1/3), alpha.e(P) = 67027/67500 < 1, while every acyclic 3-regular depth-2 edge-rooted pattern (all 81 leaf-count forms) has alpha.e(T) >= 3001/3000. So no convex combination of tree constraints is weaker than e(P). The source's optimized bounds (Lemma 10) are unaffected.

title: Two hook tableaux of size 12 with equal multisets of 8-minors: the k+4 reconstruction conjecture fails
scope: Erickson-Herden-Meddaugh-Sepanski-Hammon-Mohn-Ruiz-Bolanos (arXiv:2307.13161; J. Combin. Theory Ser. A 209 (2025) 105950), Conjecture conj:k+4: for n >= k+4 the multiset mM_k(T) of k-minors (over all jeu de taquin deletion sequences) determines a standard Young tableau. False at k = 8, n = 12. The hooks T1 (first row 1 5 7 8 12) and T2 (first row 1 2 3 7 10 11) are distinct and have identical mM_8 (19,958,400 minors each). Supplementary (ordinary mathematics, not Lean): a hook weight formula shows that no bound n >= k + c works for any constant c, with an explicit n = k+5 failure at k = 11.

title: Parameter concavity of the generalized inverse hyperbolic sine
scope: StrictConcaveOn p>log(2)/2 for every x>0 of literal integral0..x (1+t^p)^(-1/p); resolves full p>1,0<x<1 source question

title: Strict convexity of Gamma-ratio level curves
scope: For each c>1, unique positive height h_c(x) solving Gamma(h)Gamma(h+2x)/Gamma(h+x)^2=c for x>0, strictly convex on all x>0; source c2 included

title: Exact dyadic denominator law in shifted Jacobi parameters
scope: For every integer r>=1, the maximal dyadic denominator exponent of the literal kappa_r(u,v) is 2r+v2((r-1)!). Every coefficient satisfies the upper bound and the nonzero pure-u^r coefficient attains it. Odd denominator factors are allowed.

title: A convergent cascade series without geometric decay
scope: Explicit non-null binary saturated context tree with exactly one infinite branch and no infinite shift-stable subtree. Its actual fixed alpha-LIS1 fair cascade series is summable, total<=2, but has no eventual C*r^n bound for any C>0 and 0<r<1 in the source Eq.(5) length grading. Bare universal convergence remains untouched.

title: Two nested power-mean inequalities for the logarithm–arctangent mean
scope: For all distinct positive real a,b, M(a,b)<Bp(M(a,Bq(a,b)),M(Bq(a,b),b)) for BOTH (p,q)=(sqrt17,(5-sqrt17)/2) and (-sqrt17,(5+sqrt17)/2), literal log-arctangent M and real power means.

title: A negative H-eigenvalue of a reflected Steiner distance tensor
scope: On the genuine star K1,29 at order4, M from minimum connected-subgraph edge count including repeated terminals and C1=M(.,.,.,(2J/30-I).) has a negative real first-free-index H-eigenpair. One counterexample refutes universal positivity.

title: A 57-cell connected container for every fixed 11-omino
scope: The connected integer-cell witness C={|x|+|y|<=5} minus {(2,2),(2,-2),(-2,2),(-2,-2)} has 57 cells and contains every fixed 11-omino by translation. Thus a(11)<=57<58, refuting the universal formula.

title: Unbounded excess over the one-third edge-irregulator bound
scope: For every integer t>=2, a connected simple graph with 6t+1 vertices and 8t edges has exact edge-irregulator minimum 3t. Hence no real absolute c>=1 satisfies I_e(G)<=|E(G)|/3+c for every connected finite simple graph.

title: Failure of the exponential Rényi-increment threshold below one
scope: For every real 0<p<1 there exists a finite normalized truncated exponential whose iid positive-sum Rényi entropy increment strictly exceeds the exponential increment. Consequently no threshold p0 in (0,1) has the proposed exponential-maximizer property above p0.

title: There is no cubic 8-circulant nut graph: completing the existence classification of cubic polycirculant nut graphs
scope: Bašić and Damnjanović, On cubic polycirculant nut graphs, arXiv:2411.16904v1 Conjecture 16 = Conjecture 1 of the published version (Comput. Appl. Math. 2025). Their Theorem 2 excludes l in {1,2,4,5} and constructs cubic l-circulant nut graphs for l in {3,6,7} and l >= 9; l = 8 was the only open case. Proof: a single kernel character on semiregular orbit coordinates gives a symmetric signed integral 8x8 quotient with nullity exactly one (injective lift) and nonzero diagonal cofactors; cubicity forces a local grammar; an inductive kernel-checked catalogue of 194 connected subcubic supports with 1,722 isomorphism certificates, 669 augmentations and tree switching reduce to 9,172 signed matrices, each excluded by an exact determinant (8,208) or zero principal cofactor (964) certificate. Valid for all orbit sizes m, without bounding graph order.

title: A five-vertex counterexample to the nearest-colour contact-order conjecture for two-variable Cauchy transforms of coloured graphs
scope: Tully-Doyle, Adlin, Thai and Tiscareno, Cauchy transforms of colored graphs in two variables, arXiv:2410.10695 (v1 2024, v2 2025), Conjecture 6.1: the contact order at the boundary point corresponding to (infinity, 0) equals twice the distance from the root to the nearest w-coloured vertex. False: the five-vertex graph with edges 01,02,03,13,24,34, root 0 and w-vertices 1,2 has nearest-w distance 1 but contact order 6 (analytic branches of exact orders 6 and 2; local maximum-branch convention of the source and of Bickel-Hong).

title: Power-domination TAR uniqueness for complete bipartite graphs: PD^TAR(K_{s,t}) is unique if and only if s ≠ 2 and t ≠ 2
scope: Bjorkman, Bozeman, Ferrero, Flagg, Grood, Hogben, Jacob and Reinhart, Power domination reconfiguration, arXiv:2201.01798, La Matematica 5 (2026): the uniqueness conjecture stated after Proposition p:K33 (still listed open in the Curtis-Flagg-Hogben survey arXiv:2406.05509v2, 2025). Proved: the new Core Theorem (for s,t >= 3, (s,t) != (3,3), K_{A,B} is the only graph on A ⊔ B with exactly its PD sets) via fort duality, pair forts, cross-degree rigidity isolating (3,3), two-sided completeness and independence; with the published TAR relabelling reduction (Bong-Carlson-Curtis-Haas-Hogben, Graphs Combin. 2023) formalized by a self-contained Hamming-isometry proof, and the source's small cases (K_2, K_{1,t}, K_{2,t} via K_{2,t}(e), K_{1,2} vs K_3, K_{3,3}) all formalized.

title: A 15-vertex counterexample to the odd-kernel conjecture for io-decomposable Riordan graphs
scope: Cheon, Jung, Kitaev and Mojallal, Riordan graphs II: Spectral properties, arXiv:1801.07021v1 (journal accepted manuscript in the Strathclyde repository retains it), Conjecture 7.7: for a singular io-decomposable Riordan graph G_n(g, zg), X_o = 0. False: g = 1+z+z^3+z^6+z^7+z^8+z^12+z^13 at n = 15 gives a connected io-decomposable Bell Riordan graph of nullity 1 whose kernel vector has odd part (-1,0,-1,0,1,0,1,1); the same graph arises from an infinite series satisfying the Lemma 2.11 identity at every index.

title: Stable Kneser graphs violate the unit-gap diameter conjecture: D(SG(27,12)) ≥ 8 while D(SG(28,12)) ≤ 6
scope: Ledezma, Pastine, Torres, Valencia-Pabon, arXiv:2112.01884v2 (DAM 350 (2024) 15-30), Conjecture 2. False at k = 12, r = 3: D(SG(27,12)) ≥ 8 by an explicit pair (masks 21669205, 39144021) with a distance-labelling certificate, and D(SG(28,12)) ≤ 6 by BFS-tree certificates over 116 rotation-orbit representatives; the drop is 2. Independent of the source's Theorem 6 (found false; the r = 2 route was a source-internal correction and is not credited).

title: Gcd symmetry of recurrent-component sizes for the rotor network on the bidirected cycle (Chan-Levine Conjecture 8.3)
scope: Chan and Levine, Abelian networks IV. Dynamics of nonhalting networks, arXiv:1804.03322 v1/v2; Mem. Amer. Math. Soc. 276 (2022), no. 1358, Conjecture 8.3: for the rotor network on the bidirected cycle C_n, n ≥ 3, m ≥ 1, the number of recurrent configurations in the unique recurrent component C_{n,m,i} of level m and weight i depends only on gcd(n, m, i). Proved for all n ≥ 3 and m ≥ 1, in the source's network language, with component existence and uniqueness proved.

title: Valuation differences for coloured binary partitions: the full Ulas–Żmija Conjecture 6.1 picture (even formula, odd bounds, sharpness, and failure of per-colour sharpness for m ≡ 15 mod 16)
scope: Ulas and Żmija, arXiv:1904.03398v1 (Ramanujan J. 55 (2021) 623–660), Conjecture 6.1 on ν2(c_m(4n) − c_m(n)) for m-coloured binary partitions. Proved in full: the even formula ν2 = ν2(n) + 2ν2(k) + 3 for m = 2k; the bounds +3 (m ≡ 1 mod 4) and +6 (m ≡ 3 mod 4) with nonzero differences; explicit infinite equality families for m ≡ 1 (mod 4) and m ≡ 3, 7, 11 (mod 16); and for m ≡ 15 (mod 16) the universal +7 bound, so equality never holds. Hence the conjecture is false under the per-k reading and true under the some-k reading.

title: Equitable partitions of finite rectangular grids are symmetry orbits (Neuberger-Sieben-Swift Conjecture 5.6)
scope: Neuberger, Sieben and Swift, arXiv:1908.05797 (SIAM J. Appl. Dyn. Syst. 19 (2020)), Conjecture 5.6, proved for all m, n >= 1: every equitable partition of P_m □ P_n is the orbit partition of a subgroup of the automorphism group; the equitable-partition lattice is isomorphic to the subgroup lattice exactly when a free vertex exists; and a free vertex exists unless 2 <= m = n <= 3.

title: The stack-sorting degree grows faster than 1.80^n: a refutation of the Defant–Propp interval conjecture
scope: Defant and Propp, arXiv:2002.07144 v3/v4 Conjecture 4.4 (Electron. J. Combin. 27(3) (2020) P3.51, Conjecture 23), restated as open by Defant (Adv. Math. 2022): the limit lies in (1.68, 1.73). False: every limit is at least 1.73 (Lean), and the exact values through n = 82 give at least 1.80468 (ordinary exact computation); the numerical value is about 1.95.

title: A connected eight-vertex counterexample to strict increase of outer-connected domination under the middle-graph operation
scope: Kazemnejad, Pahlavsay, Palezzato and Torielli, arXiv:2206.15439, Conjecture 7.1 (γ̃c(G) < γ̃c(M(G)) for every graph of order n >= 2). False already for connected graphs: G8 (8 vertices, 11 edges) has γ̃c(G8) = 4 = γ̃c(M(G8)) under both conventions. Credit only for the connected negation; the edgeless failure is a domain artefact.

title: Five positive matchings for C_3 □ C_4: a finite counterexample to Conjecture 4.7 of arXiv:2502.02826
scope: Farrokhi D. G. and Yazdan Pour, arXiv:2502.02826v1, Conjecture 4.7 (pmd(C_m □ C_n) = 6 for m + n even or (m, n) in {(3,4), (3,6), (5,6)}). False: C_3 □ C_4 has a five-part positive matching decomposition, and pmd(C_3 □ C_4) = 5 exactly; supporting certificates show pmd = 5 also at (3,5), (3,6) and (3,7).

title: An eight-vertex counterexample to the Li–Weng rainbow vertex-disconnection Nordhaus–Gaddum conjecture (Conjecture 6.12 of arXiv:2004.06285v2)
scope: Li and Weng, Further results on the rainbow vertex-disconnection of graphs, arXiv:2004.06285v2 Conjecture 6.12 (5.12 in v1; Bull. Malays. Math. Sci. Soc. 44 (2021)): rvd(G) + rvd(Ḡ) ≥ n for connected G, Ḡ of order n ≥ 8. False: an explicit connected 8-vertex graph G (masks 202,225,232,149,232,22,23,31) with connected complement has rvd(G) = 4 and rvd(Ḡ) = 3, sum 7. Supporting evidence: 74 of the 9,888 eligible order-8 isomorphism classes fail, and three connected one-vertex extensions fail at order 9 (sum 8 < 9), so the threshold is not merely off by one.

title: A skew conference matrix of order 20 whose row code over F_19 is not MDS: a counterexample to Conjecture 5 of Etzion, Vardy and Yaakobi (arXiv:1210.5725; IEEE Trans. Inform. Theory 59 (2013) Conjecture 1)
scope: Etzion-Vardy-Yaakobi conjecture that the code of length p + 1 over Z_p generated by a conference matrix of order p + 1 is MDS of dimension (p+1)/2 and minimum distance (p+3)/2. False at p = 19: an explicit Goethals-Seidel skew conference matrix of order 20 has an F_19 row code of dimension 10 containing a nonzero codeword of weight 9 < 11.

title: Three spectral invariants do not determine geodesic growth of tree-based right-angled Coxeter groups: a counterexample to Ciobanu-Kolpakov Conjecture 1.3 (arXiv:1504.02774)
scope: Ciobanu-Kolpakov Conjecture 1.3: trees whose adjacency, complement and line-graph spectra coincide have right-angled Coxeter groups with the same geodesic growth. False: two explicit 19-vertex trees with all three characteristic polynomials equal have 37769749324097905710910 versus 37769749324097905710906 geodesic words of length 18.

title: Symmetric-shell labellings of complete full trees with even branching: proof of the even case of the Bača-Semaničová-Feňovčíková-Lai-Wang local antimagic conjecture (Fundamenta Informaticae 185 (2022), Conjecture 6.1)
scope: Bača, Semaničová-Feňovčíková, Lai and Wang, Conjecture 6.1, even case: for every complete full t-ary tree T with t ≥ 2 even, χ_la(T) = l + 1. Proved for every even t ≥ 2 and depth n ≥ 1, for every finite graph carrying the full-tree certificate.

title: A down-set counterexample to Smyth's injection conjecture on compositions (Conjecture 1.5 of arXiv:1512.04084; Order 35 (2018))
scope: Smyth's Conjecture 1.5: for all A ≥ B ≥ 0 and a ≥ b ≥ 0 there is a dominance-decreasing injection U^A_b × U^B_a → U^A_a × U^B_b. False at (A, a, B, b) = (3, 20, 2, 19): the down-set of 8 explicit partitions of 39 contains the rearranged concatenations of 1137 domain elements but only 1134 target elements.

title: A 45-letter word refuting the toroidal-grid representation-number conjecture of Alshammari, Kitaev and Pyatkin (arXiv:2507.16469, Conjecture 1)
scope: Alshammari-Kitaev-Pyatkin Conjecture 1: R(C_m □ C_n) ≥ 4 for m, n ≥ 3 and m + n ≥ 8. False at (3, 5): an explicit 45-letter 3-uniform word represents C_3 □ C_5, so its representation number is at most 3.

title: A three-weight obstruction for two copies of 3P_2 join O_2: a counterexample to Lau-Shiu Conjecture 4.1 on local antimagic chromatic numbers (arXiv:2410.17674; Utilitas Math. 124 (2025))
scope: Lau-Shiu Conjecture 4.1: chi_la(2r((2s+1)P_2 join O_m)) = 3 for r, s >= 1 and m >= 2. False at r = s = 1, m = 2: the 16-vertex graph 2(3P_2 join O_2) has no local antimagic labelling with at most three weights (and chi_la = 4 by an explicit labelling, supporting).

title: A chain-free pure YY-Delta minimum that is not minimal: a counterexample to Jeffries-Yeats Conjecture 5.1 (arXiv:2110.07764; Ann. Inst. H. Poincare D 11 (2024))
scope: Jeffries-Yeats Conjecture 5.1 for doubled 3-regular graphs. False: an 18-vertex doubled simple cubic graph has pure YY-Delta minimum order 11 (25 labelled minima, all chain-free under the faithful illustrated reading), and the selected minimum reaches order 10 by seven moves, so it is not minimal.
